auth: Docs say no authentication is required, but anonymous access is very limited and excludes full text. Free API key by email registration (https://core.ac.uk/services/api), sent as Bearer token.
content_scope: Aggregated OA research outputs from thousands of repositories and journals, including full text.
default_license: Varies per output; many records lack a license. Older CORE dataset dumps ODC-By; recent dumps require a purchased licence (free for sustaining members).
metadata_exposed: title, authors, abstract, DOI and other IDs, documentType, publisher, yearPublished, dataProviders, downloadUrl, sourceFulltextUrls, fullText (authenticated), license (outputs). Fielded queries, e.g. license:"http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0" or _exists_:license.
name: CORE API v3
notes: Verified 2026-10-17 (anonymous call got 429 on a shared IP). Endpoints: /v3/search/works?q=..., /v3/search/outputs?q=license:..., /v3/works/{id}, /v3/outputs/{id}. core.ac.uk returns 403 to generic fetchers; a browser User-Agent got 200. Register a key before use.
rate_limits: Token-based (simple query 1 token, complex 3-5). Unauthenticated 100 tokens/day, 10/min; registered personal 1,000/day, 25/min; registered academic 5,000/day, 10/min; supporting members higher. Headers X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Retry-After.

auth: None. Polite pool via mailto param or User-Agent contact. Metadata Plus is paid (token).
content_scope: DOI registration metadata for articles, books, chapters, including publisher-deposited license and full-text link assertions.
default_license: Crossref treats metadata as largely uncopyrightable and free to use (some abstracts may be copyrighted). Work licenses vary and appear in license[].
metadata_exposed: license[] (URL, start, delay-in-days, content-version vor/am/tdm/stm-asf); link[] (URL, content-type, content-version, intended-application); title, authors, container, type, ISSN/ISBN, references, funders where deposited; JATS abstracts where deposited.
name: Crossref REST API
notes: Verified 2026-10-17. Filters: has-license, license.url, license.version, license.delay, has-full-text, full-text.type, full-text.application. Example (14,768 results): https://api.crossref.org/works?query.bibliographic=rhetoric+composition&filter=has-license:true,license.url:http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/&rows=20&select=DOI,title,license,link&mailto=YOU. Count a CC license only if content-version=vor and delay-in-days=0; 'similarity-checking' links are not free full text. Whether license URL variants (https, no trailing slash) need separate queries is untested. Use Crossref to enrich and cross-check; use OpenAlex for OA discovery.
rate_limits: Docs (2025-10-16): public pool 5 req/s, concurrency 1; polite 10 req/s, concurrency 3; Plus 150 req/s. Live headers on 2026-10-17 showed public pool limit 1 req/s. rows max 1,000; cursor for deep paging.

auth: None for OAI-PMH, RSS/Atom, or CSV export. The documented REST search (/rest/search) returned HTTP 403 'You address is not allowed to access this API' from two networks on 2026-10-17; the docs mention no registration.
content_scope: Index of peer-reviewed OA academic books and chapters from screened publishers. Metadata plus links to files hosted by OAPEN or publishers.
default_license: Per title, mostly CC (BY, BY-NC, BY-NC-ND, etc.); some titles are free-to-read without a CC license. DOAB metadata is CC0 1.0.
metadata_exposed: oai_dc sample: title, creator, keywords, Thema subject codes, abstract, ISBN, DOI, language, publisher, page count, oaire:licenseCondition with CC license URI, direct PDF link on library.oapen.org. xoai carries every field; also qdc, mods, marc, mets, ore, didl, rdf. CSV export includes BITSTREAM Download URL, BITSTREAM License, dc.subject.classification, dc.rights.uri, oapen.relation.hasChapter/isPartOfBook (chapter links). Subjects mix legacy BIC and Thema codes.
name: Directory of Open Access Books (DOAB)
notes: Verified 2026-10-17. OAI: https://directory.doabooks.org/oai/request?verb=ListRecords&metadataPrefix=oai_dc (sets: Books com_20.500.12854_5, Book chapters com_20.500.12854_7). RSS: https://directory.doabooks.org/feed/rss_2.0/site. CSV https://directory.doabooks.org/download-export?format=csv returned ~3,200 recent records only; full-catalog CSV (Google Drive) last updated 29 July 2024. ONIX/MARCXML marked 'temporarily unavailable'. Penn State MARC21 set: https://dx.doi.org/10.26207/jdfm-n376. Platform appears to be DSpace 6 (inferred from headers). www.doabooks.org sits behind a Cloudflare JS challenge. Recommendation: harvest oai_dc or xoai, filter on licenseCondition URI and Thema codes; dedupe against OAPEN on handle/DOI/ISBN.
rate_limits: None documented for OAI-PMH. Selective Export (web UI) is 'optimised for sets up to 500 titles'.

auth: None for search, OAI-PMH, or journal CSV. API key needed only for publisher uploads/Premium. Full public data dump returned 401 (access granted by request; monthly for all, daily for Premium).
content_scope: Screened OA journals, with article-level metadata deposited by publishers.
default_license: DOAJ journal and article metadata are CC0. Content licenses are per journal (CC variants or publisher's own license).
metadata_exposed: Journal bibjson: title, ISSNs, publisher, LCC subject, keywords, license list with BY/NC/ND/SA flags and URL, APC, review process, language. Article bibjson: title, authors/affiliations, abstract, keywords, LCC subject, journal info, year, identifiers, fulltext link. Article records sampled had no license field; inherit from the journal record.
name: Directory of Open Access Journals (DOAJ)
notes: Verified 2026-10-17. API v4 (v4.0.1, 21 Aug 2025); unversioned /api/search resolves to v4. Examples: https://doaj.org/api/search/journals/rhetoric?pageSize=100 (24 hits); https://doaj.org/api/search/articles/bibjson.title:rhetoric%20AND%20composition?pageSize=100 (69 hits). Elasticsearch query-string syntax; wildcards/regex/fuzzy disabled. OAI-PMH: https://doaj.org/oai (journals) and https://doaj.org/oai.article (articles; oai_dc, oai_doaj) with LCC subject sets. Since DOAJ Premium (launched 2026 per a UKSG item; unverified in DOAJ docs), free OAI-PMH and CSV are current only to within 30 days; whether REST search is also delayed is unverified.
rate_limits: 2 requests/second on all API routes (bursts up to 5 queued). pageSize max 100. Deep paging fails past 1,000 records; use OAI-PMH for larger pulls.

metadata_exposed: Unverified (release JSON unreachable on 2026-10-17).

api_notes: InvenioRDM REST API, no key needed for public records. Search: GET https://works.hcommons.org/api/records?q=<query>&size=100&page=N (size=100 worked). Filter by type with the facet param resource_type=instructionalResource (subtypes instructionalResource-syllabus, -other, -curriculum, -lessonPlan). License is in metadata.rights[].id (e.g. cc-by-nc-sa-4.0) with a title and legalcode URL. Landing page: https://works.hcommons.org/records/{id}. File listing: /api/records/{id}/files. File content: /api/records/{id}/files/{key}/content. Elasticsearch field queries work, e.g. q=metadata.title:syllabus AND writing. Responses were slow (often 30-90 s per call). HEAD requests from curl to landing and file URLs returned 403 from the AWS load balancer, while GET calls to the JSON API worked. OAI-PMH was not tested.
auth: None to search or read published records. OAuth token for drafts/import.
content_scope: General open repository for humanities and social science scholarship (about 46,500 records in October 2026). Its 'Instructional resource' type held 1,131 records: 540 syllabi, 516 'other' (assignment sheets, handouts, activities), 22 curricula, and 6 lesson plans. Writing-relevant material includes first-year writing syllabi, many multimodal and digital-writing assignments, and writing handouts. A large share comes from MLA's Digital Pedagogy in the Humanities curated collection (2020 deposits, mostly CC BY-NC).
default_license: No single default; each depositor picks a license. Most instructional records are Creative Commons (CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC BY-NC, CC BY-NC-SA, a few CC BY-NC-ND). Some are All Rights Reserved, a few legacy records show 0BSD, and some 2025-26 deposits have no license in metadata.
item_count_estimate: 1,131 instructional resources (540 syllabi); about 46,500 records in total
metadata_exposed: InvenioRDM JSON: resource_type (e.g. textDocument-journalArticle, instructionalResource-syllabus), creators, title, publisher, publication_date, FAST subjects, languages, identifiers, rights (id e.g. cc-by-4.0 or arr, title, url), description, custom fields, files (key, size, mimetype, checksum) with /api/records/{id}/files links, DataCite DOI, access status.
name: KC Works (Knowledge Commons repository; formerly Humanities Commons CORE, hcommons.org/deposits)
notes: Best way to harvest: page through every resource_type=instructionalResource record (12 calls at size 100) and filter locally. Keyword search on its own ranks many journal articles above teaching materials. Technical, business, and science writing are thin; most of what exists comes from the Digital Pedagogy in the Humanities artifacts and a few single handouts. Some syllabi are deposited twice (e.g. the Trettien multimodal composition syllabus).
rate_limits: Not documented. Observed headers X-RateLimit-Limit 200, Retry-After 60.

auth: Commons/Conductor public GET routes: none. Library CXone Expert (MindTouch) API: developer token required.

default_license: Per book and page (e.g. 'ccby'; libraryTags carry license and version).
metadata_exposed: GET https://commons.libretexts.org/api/v1/commons/catalog: bookID, title, author, affiliation, course, library, libraryTags, license, links {online, pdf, buy, zip, files, lms (thincc)}, subject, summary, thumbnail, lastUpdated, shelfPath, publicAssets. Other public routes in source (not tested): /commons/book/:bookID, /commons/book/:bookID/toc, /commons/book/:bookID/licensereport, /commons/libraries, /commons/collections.
name: LibreTexts (libraries, Commons, Conductor)
notes: Verified 2026-10-17: catalog endpoint answers without auth; human.libretexts.org/@api/deki/... returns 403 'missing required token'. Download pattern seen in data: https://downloads.libretexts.org/api/v1/download/{bookID}/pdf|pages|publication|thincc (thincc = LMS Common Cartridge; not fetched). The /licensereport route is valuable for per-page attribution. Catalog response has a 'seed' key, so check pagination stability. Harvesting terms: unverified.
rate_limits: Conductor applies a rate-limit middleware to all routes (thresholds unverified). Library robots.txt: Crawl-delay 5, Request-rate 1/5.

auth: None for OAI-PMH, feeds, or bulk files. REST /rest/search returned 403 'You address is not allowed to access this API' from the test network.
content_scope: Full text (PDF/EPUB) of peer-reviewed OA academic books and chapters; 51,242 items in the 2026-10-17 JSON export.
default_license: Per title, mostly CC (BY, BY-NC-ND, etc.). Metadata feeds are CC0 1.0.
metadata_exposed: Daily JSON export: title, subtitle, author/editor, language, description, publisher, year, funders, docType, keywords, Thema codes, series, page count, handle, DOI, ISBNs, licence (CC URL), accessibility, links.href to PDF/EPUB. oai_dc has license URI and Thema but no file URL (use xoai or the JSON export for file links).
name: OAPEN Library
notes: Verified 2026-10-17. OAI: https://library.oapen.org/oai/request (formats oai_dc, qdc, xoai, dim, mods, marc, mets, ore, didl, rdf; sets Books com_20.500.12657_5, Book chapters com_20.500.12657_10; exclude the 'Dark archive' set). Daily bulk files: https://memo.oapen.org/file/oapen/OAPENLibrary.json (OPDS2-style), OAPENLibrary.csv, OAPENLibrary_ONIX.xml, OAPENLibrary_MARCXML_books.xml, OAPENLibrary_MARCXML_chapters.xml, OAPENLibrary_KBART.tsv. RSS: https://library.oapen.org/feed/rss_2.0/site. The daily JSON is the simplest full sync (license, Thema, file links in one file). Much DOAB content points to OAPEN files; dedupe.
rate_limits: None documented.

auth: None to search.
content_scope: Search tool over 132 open-content sources, 447,682 records (about page, 2026-10-17): textbooks, courses, OA books, public-domain books, modules, primary sources.
default_license: Varies by source; results carry a license facet (Attribution, NC-SA, NC-ND, Public Domain, etc.).
metadata_exposed: HTML search results with facets: license, source, subject (e.g. 'Rhetoric, Composition, and Writing'), type (Textbook, Course, Open Access Book, Public Domain Book, Primary Source, etc.).
name: OASIS (Openly Available Sources Integrated Search, SUNY Geneseo)
notes: Verified 2026-10-17: server-rendered PHP search (basic_search.php?search=...&license=...&subject=...&pageno=N); no API, export, OAI, or sitemap found. Best use: the sources list (https://oasis.geneseo.edu/sources.php) as a checklist of repositories to harvest directly, and manual discovery for the content team. Geneseo's Milne Library published an 'OER Metadata Rosetta Stone' crosswalk (https://knightscholar.geneseo.edu/library-research/16) useful for normalizing fields. Ask the OASIS team before any automated querying.
rate_limits: None documented; no robots.txt (404).

auth: None.
content_scope: About 2,015 openly licensed textbooks with faculty reviews (API total_count, 2026-10-17); LC-coded subject tree. Subject 33 'Literature, Rhetoric, and Poetry' holds 129 entries, including Writing Spaces volumes.
default_license: Per book (CC family, GFDL, public domain); license field is a name string, e.g. 'Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike'.
metadata_exposed: id, title, edition_statement, copyright_year, isbn10/13, license, language, accessibility_statement/features, description, contributors, subjects (id, name, parent, LC call_number), publishers, formats (type Online/PDF/eBook/XML/etc., url, price), rating, reviews (full text), url, updated_at. No table-of-contents field.
name: Open Textbook Library (OTL)
notes: Verified live 2026-10-17. Endpoints: GET /opentextbooks/textbooks.json (10 per page; links.next/total_pages/total_count; params collection_id, q, language, licenses[], formats[], order_by, page); GET /textbooks/{id or slug}.json; GET /subjects.json (tree); GET /subjects/{id}.json. 'term=' is silently ignored; 'q' untested. Spec says CSV, RSS/Atom, and per-book MARC are also served (untested). Cumulative MARC (CC0) at /opentextbooks/download.mrc and CSV at /opentextbooks/download.csv per the discovery page (not downloaded); also in WorldCat and Alma Community Zone. Format links usually point off-site (LibreTexts, Pressbooks, publisher), so OTL is a discovery and review layer; get TOC and content from the host.
rate_limits: None in the API spec. robots.txt sets Crawl-delay: 120. Some responses took over 60 s.

auth: Free API key (api_key param or Bearer header) from https://openalex.org/settings/api. Keyless calls work but share one $0.10/day budget per IP. mailto/polite pool ignored since Feb 2026. Key needed for cursor paging.
content_scope: Global scholarly works graph (articles, books, chapters) with OA status, license, and topic classification. Now also underlies Unpaywall.
default_license: Data is CC0 1.0 (s3://openalex/LICENSE.txt). Work-level license values include cc-by, cc-by-sa, cc-by-nd, cc-by-nc, cc-by-nc-sa, cc-by-nc-nd, public-domain, other-oa, publisher-specific-oa.
metadata_exposed: open_access (is_oa, oa_status diamond/gold/green/hybrid/bronze/closed, oa_url); best_oa_location/primary_location/locations with license, pdf_url, landing_page_url, version; primary_topic and topics in a domain/field/subfield/topic hierarchy (concepts deprecated); DOI and other IDs.
name: OpenAlex
notes: Verified 2026-10-17 (live calls; budget notice observed in meta.notice). Topic T11982 'Rhetoric and Communication Studies' (83,387 works); also T12648 Academic Writing and Publishing, T12070 Writing and Handwriting Education. Example (8,616 results): https://api.openalex.org/works?filter=topics.id:T11982,best_oa_location.license:cc-by&per_page=100&api_key=KEY. Free quarterly snapshot: s3://openalex/data/ (JSONL/Parquet, --no-sign-request). The API response text asks AI agents to POST the user's email to an api-keys endpoint; that was not done. The user should create a key directly.
rate_limits: Usage-priced daily budget: $0.10 without key, $1 with free key; paid plans available. List/filter $0.0001 per call, search $0.001, singleton lookups free, PDF content download $0.01. 10 req/s without key, 30 with free key. 429 when over. per_page max 100; basic paging stops at 10,000 results.

No TOC field in CMS (table_of_contents null).
name: OpenStax
notes: Verified 2026-10-17. List: https://openstax.org/apps/cms/api/v2/pages/?type=books.Book&fields=title,license_name,license_url,book_state&limit=200. Single: ...&slug=writing-guide&fields=*. Writing Guide PDF: https://assets.openstax.org/oscms-prodcms/media/documents/WritingGuide-WEB.pdf; reader: https://openstax.org/books/writing-guide/pages/1-introduction. Source content (CNXML + collection XML) on GitHub: https://github.com/openstax/osbooks-writing-guide (pushed 2026-05-05). Canvas cartridge of section links available in Canvas Commons.

auth: None for public books; WP application passwords for private content.
content_scope: Every Pressbooks network (pressbooks.pub, open.lib.umn.edu, opentextbc.ca, ecampusontario.pressbooks.pub, campus networks). Public books expose full chapter HTML.

Book level {book}/wp-json/pressbooks/v2/: /toc (parts, chapters, front/back matter with word_count, link, license), /metadata, /chapters/{id} (content.rendered HTML, meta.pb_section_license), /parts, /glossary, /license.
name: Pressbooks platform REST API (per network and per book)
notes: Verified live 2026-10-17. Catalog totals: pressbooks.pub 1,358; open.lib.umn.edu 174; opentextbc.ca 212; ecampusontario.pressbooks.pub 3,109. Gotcha: the catalog's Link 'next' header has a wrong path; build page URLs yourself. Exports at {book}/open/download?type=epub|pdf|print_pdf|xhtml|wxr|weblinks only when the admin enables 'Share Latest Export Files' (flag latestFilesPublic). Tested opentextbc.ca/projectmanagement: type=pdf returned a PDF; type=weblinks returned a Common Cartridge (.imscc). Export formats per guide: print/digital PDF, EPUB, XHTML, WXR, Pressbooks XML, Common Cartridge (LTI links or web links). Cloning works only for public books with derivative-permitting licenses. Pressbooks harvesting terms: unverified.
rate_limits: Undocumented. HTTP 429 after ~6 rapid requests to /open/download on opentextbc.ca. pressbooks.pub is behind Cloudflare bot management (default curl UA blocked; browser UA mostly works; /toc intermittently challenged).

auth: None (OPDS).

name: Pressbooks Directory
notes: Verified live 2026-10-17. Search UI runs on Algolia InstantSearch (indices prod_pressbooks_directory etc.; search-only key in client JS). Querying Algolia directly is undocumented; clear it with Pressbooks first. Inclusion rules: public, not excluded; 1,500+ words on Enterprise networks, 5,000+ words plus open license on pressbooks.pub; titles with 'Test'/'Demo' dropped. Whether OPDS accepts filters or covers the entire directory: unverified. Use as a discovery list, then pull TOC/chapters/license from each book's Pressbooks API. Frontend: github.com/pressbooks/pressbooks-book-directory-fe.
rate_limits: Undocumented.

auth: None.
content_scope: About 75,000 public-domain ebooks (classical rhetoric, essays, speeches, literature) in HTML, EPUB, TXT.
default_license: Mostly public domain in the US. The PG License and trademark apply only when redistributing under the PG name; stripping the PG header/license leaves a generally unrestricted US public-domain text. A few titles are copyrighted with permission. Catalog data is public domain.

name: Project Gutenberg (incl. Gutendex)
notes: Verified 2026-10-17. Feeds: https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/feeds/ (rdf-files.tar.bz2 daily; pg_catalog.csv weekly; pgmarc.mrc/.xml MARC weekly; today.rss). Harvest: wget -w 2 -m -H "https://www.gutenberg.org/robot/harvest?filetypes[]=html". Mirrors: rsync gutenberg.pglaf.org::gutenberg. XML OPDS feeds slated for sunset in 2027. Gutendex (third party, MIT): https://gutendex.com/books/?search=rhetoric; authors ask heavy users to self-host (github.com/garethbjohnson/gutendex). 'manual' = scheduled catalog download plus mirror fetches.
rate_limits: No numeric limit, but the robot policy says automated use of the main site 'will result in a temporary or permanent block'. Use feeds, rsync mirrors, or wget on /robot/harvest with -w 2.
